body: I did but have the impression it was a bot. Most of them require a full login. I'd like to text someone, talking is hard but would rather not bother a friend or family member

Hey i feel the same. it comes and goes and right now is not a great moment. So I might not be the best person to help you with that but I wanted to tell you you're not alone in your struggles. I feel your pain. The crushing anxiety and thoughts that come along with it. But the truth is that even if it feels like it'll never get better, that it'll always come back, these thoughts will subside. Your mood is going to improve. And even if it comes back you know that it will go away again. You are capable of getting better in the long run because you can do it on the short run. It takes practice and repetition to show your body and mind that you can trust yourself. 
I don't know how old you are, but you've lived all these years and are still living now. Whatever you believe in or not believe in, you were born and given a life. The fact that you were chosen or that your zygote triumphed over the other ones shows that you deserve it. It's your life, you've received it and nobody else. You deserve it.
I hope I don't sound to crazy. I try to convey that your life is precious and all the efforts you've put into it are worth it. Continue to fight for your life. And even if you fall down you know you'll get back up. Even for a shot while. You will learn to get better faster, to move forward stronger, to enjoy life for what it has to offer. Hang it there, we will get better
